text: What is the difference between == and === in JavaScript?
idealAnswer: == does type coercion before comparing, === compares value and type without coercion. Prefer === to avoid unexpected coercion bugs.

text: Explain the difference between SQL and NoSQL databases, with an example use case for each.
idealAnswer: SQL: structured, relational, fixed schema, good for complex queries and transactional data (e.g. banking). NoSQL: flexible schema, horizontally scalable, good for unstructured/rapidly changing data (e.g. product catalogs, logs).
